content.thinking: The page is a dark, English-heavy one that's usually not for me, but the task "ת"א-125" is already marked white, so I'll move on and keep the sums of 10,000 and 500 monthly as they are.

The narration is Hebrew; the figure 86,045 ₪ is the one that matters, along with the "פסגות" name that Claude doesn't recognize as a bank, and the question of who chose it. Claude's own stance is that it did not pick this fund and is avoiding the minus box.

Rewritten: The projection shows 86,045 ₪ left in 10 years, but the cheap option listed is "פסגות" ניירות ערך, which I don't recognize as a bank and didn't choose. I'm steering clear of the −1,030 figure.
ההמלצה כרגע: פסגות ראשון, אך הבנקים הגדולים גובים יותר; לאומי ו"וואן זירו" בולטים בעמלות גבוהות, והאי.בי.אי מסומן באדום, ולכן אני בודק את המחירים לפני המשך.
The fund page marks אי.בי.אי. מחקה as the choice, and its minus-sign figures look like losses, though I don't recognise the terms. This is my seventh screen, so I'll check one more.

הסבר קצר על המדד: "+" פירושו שהקרן הקדימה את המדד, "−" שפיגרה אחריו, ולא הפסד כסף. לגבי ה-18,905 ₪, אני לא מבין איך מתקבל הסכום הזה משינוי של 20% באחד המספרים, ולכן אני עוצר כאן כי העיניים שלי עייפות מכמה מסכים.

input.answer: According to the page, I'd open the account at פסגות (marked "הזול") and buy "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125". With 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month, it says I'd have about 86,045 ₪ after ten years. But that's on the page's example of 7% a year, and פסגות isn't a bank, so I won't do anything until I've asked my son.

stuck.why: It says 'your choice' but I never chose פסגות. The page chose it, and I didn't know why at first.

Every fund has a minus (−0.04%, −1,030 ₪). I almost backed away from all of them before I found the small explanation at the bottom of the list.
There's a price for women from 60, which is me, but it says 'סגור למצטרפים'. I'm not sure if that still helps an old customer.
